stimulus: NoteFlow — AI-generated meeting summaries and action items for your team's video calls and chat tool. $15/user/month, joins your calls automatically, no manual transcript review needed. 14-day free trial, no credit card required to start.
custom_segment_description: US/EU startup and SMB knowledge workers who run frequent video meetings

outcome.label: moderate
outcome.evidence: publicly-known pattern for standalone AI meeting-notes SaaS tools: solid early adoption via free trials and word-of-mouth, but tapering retention and pricing pressure as the video-conferencing and productivity-suite incumbents shipped equivalent AI note-taking features natively into their existing bundles.

provenance.disguise_notes: no specific brand or company named; value prop (per-seat AI meeting summarizer with a no-card free trial) and evidence structure (early traction eroded by incumbent bundling) preserved from the publicly-known pattern
